name: stock-price-predictor
description: Pure Java 17 AWT + JDBC + SQLite desktop application for CSE 213 Advanced Java Programming at SRM University AP.

scripts.build: (command -v mvn >/dev/null 2>&1 || (apt-get update -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends openjdk-17-jdk maven xvfb)) && mvn -B clean compile dependency:build-classpath -Dmdep.outputFile=target/classpath.txt
